provider: Tencent Cloud COS — new-user free tier

free_tier.stated: 50 GB STANDARD storage capacity, valid 6 months (180 days), new users only. Some third-party summaries claim enterprise accounts get 1 TB/month for 6 months — not stated on the vendor page I read, so unverified.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Explicitly NOT covered: 'The free quota resource packages cannot be used to offset billable items for non-STANDARD storage usage, such as ... requests, and traffic.' Public network downstream traffic is billed from byte one at ~$0.1/GB.

tooling: COS XML/S3-compatible API. Rclone 's3' provider 'Tencent Cloud Object Storage (COS)'; COSCLI; SDKs. Public-read buckets and pre-signed URLs supported.
chaining: One free package per new account; 50 GB x 6 months. Account multiplication requires separate verified identities.
limits_note: 50 GB, 6 months, storage only. Egress and requests are never free. 'user downloaded 10 GB .. 0.1 x 10 = 1 USD' in the vendor's own billing example.
